response:
Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) is not considered a significant indicator of the development of vascularization in hypovascular hepatocellular lesions. In fact, according to retrieved matches, DWI showed no significant difference in the development of vascularization on repeated scans.

In fact, one match states that "The signal intensity on DWI showed no significant difference in the development of vascularization." This suggests that DWI is not effective in identifying changes in vascularization in hypovascular hepatocellular lesions.
